description: This file defines a React hook useKeyNavigation that handles keyboard events for navigating slides, toggling help, and closing help modals in a presentation-like application.

methods.name: useKeyNavigation({ onPrev, onNext, onFirst, onLast, onToggleHelp, onCloseHelp })
methods.description: Handles slide navigation keys: ArrowLeft/Right, Home, End, Space. Also toggles help modal with '?' and closes it with Escape.

ctags.name: useKeyNavigation
ctags.pattern: /^export function useKeyNavigation({ onPrev, onNext, onFirst, onLast, onToggleHelp, onCloseHelp })/
ctags.signature: ({ onPrev, onNext, onFirst, onLast, onToggleHelp, onCloseHelp })
